summary: Smart Powerr Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a registered direct offering of 4,500,000 common shares at $0.45 per share, raising ~$2M in gross proceeds. The transaction closed on May 20, 2026, with an option for purchasers to buy an additional 4,500,000 shares within 30 days. The company will use net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or unusual structural features are present beyond standard lock-up provisions on further equity issuance for 30-60 days. There is no deal premium, going-private element, or restructuring involved.
